messages:
maria_devex: quick heads-up — i'm proposing a schema normalization for route quotas + console metrics. plan in short: 1) extract route.tags (jsonb) into a normalized route_tags table, 2) add route_quota_profile_id on routes, 3) add metrics.denorm_route_id + route_tag_fingerprint for fast OLAP joins. will require shadow-write + backfill. feedback? :eyes:

oliver_eng: high-level q — how will this affect the console dashboards/queries? biggest worry is adding joins to hot aggregations.

maria_devex: good call. goal is to avoid extra joins in the common read path. primary reads will use denorm_route_id and a compact tag fingerprint (64-bit hash). the normalized tables are for admin UX/authoritative joins and for editing tags. we'll keep legacy jsonb until cutover for safety.

sara_platform: two concerns: 1) dashboard queries that do GROUP BY tags today, 2) UX for rollouts — how do product & support preview the new values? suggest dual-read feature flag and console toggle to switch read path per-tenant.

tim_sre: operational concerns: backfill of telemetry -> denorm fields can blow up WAL and IO. need chunked jobs, rate-limits, and monitorable checkpoints. also what's the expected row count?

maria_devex: estimated numbers: ~120M telemetry rows for last 90 days, ~6M route records, ~800k distinct tag combinations. backfill approach: per-tenant chunked worker that reads events in time windows and writes denorm_route_id + tag_fingerprint. pseudocode snippet i plan to include in PR:

```sql
-- idempotent upsert for route_tags
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS route_tags (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  route_id UUID NOT NULL,
  tag_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  tag_value TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(route_id, tag_key, tag_value)
);

INSERT INTO route_tags (route_id, tag_key, tag_value)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
```

and backfill worker (pseudo):

```py
for tenant in tenants:
  for window in windows(tenant):
    rows = select telemetry where ts in window and tenant=tenant
    compute denorm_route_id and fingerprint
    batch_update rows with denorm fields (idempotent)
```

oliver_eng: will fingerprints be stable across runs? if we use different hashing algorithms later, we could diverge and break dashboards that rely on equality. Maybe store both fingerprint + materialized tag tuple for short retention?

maria_devex: plan: fingerprint = siphash64(tags_normalized_sorted) — stable algorithm documented in migration PR. we'll also keep the legacy jsonb column for 30 days post-backfill as a safety net. after cutover we can garbage collect.

sara_platform: for rollouts UX — i can add a console toggle called `route_quota_v2` exposed to admins so we can switch a tenant, validate metrics for 48h, then flip fleet-wide. i'll also add a preview panel that reads both old and new values side-by-side.

ingest-bot: migration-runner scheduled: backfill-job-2177777777 created for 2026-04-20T02:00:00Z, chunk-size=50000, rate-limit=200/s

tim_sre: +1 on runbook and kill-switch. please add these metrics to alerting: backfill-progress, DB-bloat-rate, WAL-throughput, worker OOMs, and we need a manual pause endpoint for the job.

maria_devex: will open the migration PR today with: schema DDL, backfill plan, job configs, runbook, and the siphash implementation. will include sample queries for dashboards (old vs new) and a smoke test script.

oliver_eng: nice. i'll review the PR and run the fingerprint tool locally against a CC snapshot. can you add estimate for total IO and wall time in the PR?

sara_platform: i'll update dashboard templates and put fallback queries in place. also adding note to rollout playbook for support to expect transient metric deltas during 48h verification. :white_check_mark:

maria_devex: thanks — merging plan into docs after PR. tagging @oliver_eng @tim_sre for review. any other blockers?

oliver_eng: none from me, just the usual review cycle.

tim_sre: none here, as long as runbook + alerts land before we start.

maria_devex: great — will post PR link here when ready.
